answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, released only after three unrelated confirmations, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The glacier lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the relic is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The anchor of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
